name: Maclure Vineyards
summary: In southern Elwynn, Maclure Vineyards sends grapes and wine to Stormwind. The Maclure family's estate is known as much for its bitter feud with the neighboring Stonefields as for its harvest.

sections.title: A Bitter Harvest
sections.body: The Maclure Vineyards should be a peaceful haven of farming and winecraft in southern Elwynn Forest. Instead, the feud with the Stonefields down the road overshadows the family's daily labor. Accusations of theft and old resentment keep tempers high between the households. Hungry boars prowl the land, while kobolds press toward both homesteads.

sections.title: A Forbidden Romance
sections.body: Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield have fallen secretly in love despite their families' bitter feud. They meet in hidden groves, away from their parents' suspicious eyes. Travelers through the vineyards are drawn into carrying secret messages, settling petty grievances, and helping the young couple seek a life together beyond their families' grudge.

faq.q: Why are the Maclures and Stonefields fighting?
aliases: why do they hate each other
faq.answer: The Maclures and Stonefields have a long rural feud rooted in years of mistrust, petty accusations, and stubborn pride. Each family blames the other for lost goods and livestock, though neither has proof of foul play.

Maybell is the daughter of the Maclure household. She has secretly fallen in love with Tommy Joe Stonefield, defying her family's hatred of their neighbors and hoping they can find a way to be together.

faq.q: What threats do the vineyards face?
faq.answer: The vineyards face family disputes, hungry wild boars that trample crops and vines, and kobolds from nearby gold mines who raid the surrounding fields.

faq.q: What do the Maclures produce here?
faq.answer: The Maclure family grows grapes for wine and fresh fruit, supplying tavern-keepers and merchants throughout Elwynn Forest and Stormwind City.

angles.text: For humans of Stormwind, the feud shows the stubbornness of the countryside. Even in the kingdom's heartland, neighbors quarrel over fences while greater perils loom.
The estate supplies food and spirits to nearby Goldshire and Stormwind City.
